description: Fuse UTF-8 validation into the SIMD structural character detection pass, validating multi-byte sequences while simultaneously scanning for delimiters. Exploits the fact that CSV structural characters are all single-byte ASCII, so any byte >= 0x80 is non-structural.
mathematical_formalization: For valid UTF-8: structural_mask & utf8_continuation_mask == 0. Fused cost: C_fused = max(C_structural, C_utf8) vs. C_separate = C_structural + C_utf8. Saving: ~2 additional SIMD instructions per 32-byte block.
analogical_connections: Lemire's simdutf library: validates and transcodes UTF-8 at GB/s
Compiler loop fusion: merging two passes over the same data
Video codec optimization: fusing entropy decode with inverse transform
implementation_hypothesis: After computing delimiter bitmasks, add UTF-8 checks: identify bytes >= 0x80, verify continuation byte patterns, validate leading byte length indicators. Reuse same SIMD register loads.
experiment_seed: Benchmark fused vs. separate UTF-8 validation on pure ASCII, 10% non-ASCII, and 80% non-ASCII CSV. Verify malformed UTF-8 detection parity.
